title: Perfect
text:
The driver was early, he loaded the luggage, and we arrived at the airport as planned. 
PERFECT!
We gave him a good tip too.
author: djcanovamsncom

title: Today was wonderful. My wife and I had a really great time.
text: Today was my birthday and I wanted to do something special and different so we decided to this. It was amazing.
author: Randy_L

title: Great way to reach your destination
text: It was hard to figure out where to find our driver  at airport because we weren't familiar with it but the driver came and found us and the communication was good to help us reach each other. Thanks!
author: Kristeen_L
